caseName: Division 26 of the Amalgamated Ass'n of Street, Electric Railway & Motor Coach Employees v. City of Detroit
caseNameFull: Division 26 of the Amalgamated Association of Street, Electric Railway & Motor Coach Employees of America v. City of Detroit
attorneys: Edward N. Barnard for appellants., James H. Lee for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas dissent. Mr. Justice Burton is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
